description: Level 3 Phase 2 (world expansion and environment): validation of the district built by src/district.js, run on the dev server (vite :5173) in the Claude desktop app's built-in Chromium with the Browser pane hidden (a background page), AMD Radeon integrated GPU. Branch level3, on top of Stage 0 (uncommitted).

walkRoute.route: A (Avenue, through the roadblock's east-pavement gap)

walkRoute.note: the walker's straight line met the metro balustrade and steered round it (route since adjusted)
cameraInsideAt: building corner at the Passage exit, one 0.1 s sample

walkRoute.note: first version of the test route put waypoints inside a parked car and a van; nudged by hand, route since corrected
walkRoute.cameraInsideAt: thin props for one 0.1 s sample each: a Morris column, a candelabra pole, a van end

performance.caveat: Measured with the Browser pane hidden: absolute milliseconds are about ten times the archived frame-times.json figures and vary by +-40% between identical passes, so only draw calls, triangles and relative cost are meaningful.

level1_after_visiting_level3.note: the hidden district adds no draw calls or triangles

level3.programs: 75-89 depending on what has been on screen; Level 2's fights reach 79

districtBuild.note: first entry to Level 3 only; includes canvas textures and renderer.compile of the whole scene (programs 41 -> 80), which keeps compiles out of play. Over the 400 ms design target.

performance.lights: unchanged: no light added; lamp pools, lit windows and signs are unlit materials, police and fire glow use the existing pooled lights

build: npm run build: clean; main bundle 1,019.99 kB (295.87 kB gzip), dev chunk 40.89 kB
